note: USE_URI off: plain open treats file: as a literal path (14); OPEN_URI parses and creates the real path
URI mode=ro forces readonly (write rc 8); unknown vfs param errors no such vfs
URI mode=memory: in-memory db, no disk file
open_v2 flag matrix: READONLY missing 14 / existing write 8; RW-without-CREATE 14; MEMORY flag; zero flags MISUSE
sqlite3_uri_parameter/int64/boolean over the opened URI; db_filename; :memory: filename empty string
urifuncs SQL surface ABSENT on the bare pin (no such function: uri_parameter)
authorizer args for PRAGMA get/set, TRANSACTION BEGIN/COMMIT, ATTACH, DETACH
SQLITE_IGNORE semantics: INSERT/UPDATE skipped, DELETE proceeds (truncate-opt only)
multi-page backup: pagecount>1, remaining tracks step quanta exactly, DONE at 0, dest content verified
source write between steps restarts the copy; dest sees the late write
ROWS frame EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW / NO OTHERS / GROUP / TIES change frame membership
offset RANGE frames (1P/1F, 2P/0F) group by peer values; RANGE + EXCLUDE GROUP composes
sqlite3_config after init: threading modes/MEMSTATUS/URI -> MISUSE; LOG + PCACHE_HDRSZ legal; bad op MISUSE
db_config ENABLE_TRIGGER: default 1, off suppresses firing, on restores
db_config ENABLE_VIEW: off -> access to view prohibited, on restores
db_config DQS_DML: default on accepts double-quoted strings, off errors with C hint; DEFENSIVE toggle rc; bad op
stmt_isexplain 0/2 round-trip via sqlite3_stmt_explain (rc 0, bad mode 1); prepared EQP reports 2; EQP column shape
